attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 870780)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Control
Fandom (control.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://control.fandom.com/wiki/Control
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page (no completion stage in its page data) whose Walkthrough and mission subpages are linked but not written; only Assets, Collectibles, Controls, Gameplay, Personal Mods, Service Weapon, Table of Contents and Weapon Mods exist, so no structure was taken. control.fandom.com answers the API, with about 105 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is 870780, listed in the store list as "CONTROL Ultimate Edition" (its schema calls it "Control"). RAWG lists two add-ons, "Control: The Foundation" and "Control: AWE". 23 of 67 Steam achievements are hidden. 11 hidden ones share names with StrategyWiki mission page links and are clearly story. The achievements from "< Make/Unmake >" onward in the schema (plus "Niche Position" and "Chief Investigator") mention the Foundation, the Investigations Sector, Rangers or Surge, so they were grouped as expansion content; that grouping, and putting the last two hidden ones ("Work Smarter, Not Harder", "Surge of Power") there by schema position, is an inference. The other hidden ones (such as "Altered Manifestations May Occur", "Vending Spree") sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; several have low unlock rates and are probably optional.
